description:
## 💡 Fix Description
                                                                               
 Problem: Plugin context stored in HTTP_PRE_REQUEST hooks was not accessible in TOOL_PRE_INVOKE hooks when tools were invoked via the /mcp endpoint.       
          
 Changes Made                                                                         
                                                                                 
 1. Code Fix in mcpgateway/transports/streamablehttp_transport.py (lines 1331-1357):                                       
 - Added plugin context extraction from mcp_app.request_context
 - Pass plugin_context_table and plugin_global_context to tool_service.invoke_tool()                                       
 - Added graceful error handling for missing context                 
                                                                                 
 2. Tests Added in tests/unit/mcpgateway/transports/test_streamablehttp_transport.py:                                      
 - test_call_tool_passes_plugin_contexts - Verifies contexts are properly extracted and passed                                  
 - test_call_tool_handles_missing_request_context - Verifies graceful handling when context unavailable

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Lint suite                            | `make lint`          |Pass    |
| Unit tests                            | `make test`          |Pass    |
